from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):\n    """Recolor complete horizontal or vertical lines of 8 to 2."""\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    rows = {r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for c in range(w))}\n    cols = {c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))}\n    return [[2 if r in rows or c in cols else v for c, v in enumerate(row)] for r, row in enumerate(grid)]\n'''
path=progdir/'task-b13b7317.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
